title: The ring cover
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Friday. The cover is the ash ring on the plank, close, the tube beside it. Gray. A circle. The owner says it's a burn. Wood says it's the red one. She looks at the gray ring and says she can see that.

panels.composition: The cover: an ash ring on a dock plank, a spent tube, the wood grain. Close. Gray.

panels.composition: The laundromat. The LAUNDRY owner. WOOD. BARNABY.
